files.description: Core EHI export documentation (b)(10). 6-page PDF (4 pages legal boilerplate, 2 pages technical). Describes the PARADIGM FHIR Data Portability module: ZIP export containing C-CDA XML per patient, supplemental JSON files (e.g. invoice history), and attached files in original format. Documents two REST API endpoints for patient search and C-CDA retrieval. No data dictionary, no JSON schema, no sample data.

FHIR R4 API documentation for (g)(10) certification. 27-page PDF documenting OAuth 2.0/PKCE authentication and 16+ US Core FHIR resource types (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Immunization, MedicationRequest, Observation, Procedure, Encounter, Provenance, plus supporting resources). Includes request/response parameters and example JSON for each resource. This documents the standardized FHIR API, not the broader EHI export.

Patient API documentation. 6-page PDF (4 pages legal boilerplate, 2 pages technical). Documents the non-FHIR REST API at api.qrshs.com/v1/ for patient search (by name/DOB/SSN) and C-CDA retrieval (by patient ID with optional date range). Uses Basic auth. Same endpoints referenced in the EHI export documentation.

Main disclosures page HTML. Static page listing all QRS compliance documents including Real World Testing plans/results, EHI export documentation, FHIR API docs, Patient API docs, and privacy/security attestations. Serves as the index/navigation page for all vendor documentation.
